Tens of thousands protest Spain's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis

Tens of thousands of people rallied across Spain, particularly in Madrid, to protest the government's management of the Ceuta migrant crisis. Opposition parties accused Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of abandoning the residents of Ceuta. The crisis has deepened, with reports suggesting Morocco's involvement. Prime Minister Sánchez stated that officers "chose to defend human life" during the surge of migrants. The situation has led to turmoil within the Spanish government and is being framed as part of a new era of rising hybrid threats in Europe.
